content: Ieisu qabu qiduana veʼainidi
Ta vaina tuta ʼabibodanaya Ieisu gelu vaukamana lavu Galili mali diʼwenaya, ta lavu nana wese igabea ana wawa mwadeʼwa Taibilia.
Ta qabu qidua vaʼinedi Ieisu iʼabiboda dadanea, mana ena viaqa waiwaidi tovevihiqa weaqidi niʼa iʼitedi.
ʼInega Ieisu ma ana toʼabibodayavo bwanagaya iʼwatovu itoabui,
ta tuta goyona me Diu edi ʼebenuaveʼavina ʼAuvivia Sagalina ana tuta naʼifoqe.
ʼInega Ieisu ʼita givigivila ta qabu diavona ʼitedi imaimai. ʼInega Ieisu Filifi vonea vonaya, “Filifi, maʼinega ana fata beledi kana gimwanei be baʼe qabu dina kana veʼainidi?”
Ieisu ena vetalaʼai baʼe ʼinega nuanuana nanoqolia maʼoda Filifi navona ʼaiqa, mana Ieisu taunega niʼa alamania tolaʼai ʼibaʼigo naviaqia qabu dina weaqidi.

ʼInega Filifi veʼiea vonaya, “ʼEguma beledi kana gimwanedi tomotau qabudi weaqidi ʼinega ana maisa navaneqa kavona tomotau adi yau 200 edi fewa ʼaubena ʼaidegina ana maisa ʼidewani, ta tua ana ʼita mane nana ʼinega tomotau qabudi ge ana fata be ina ʼai ta gamodi nakoko.”
ʼInega Saimoni Fita taina Anidulu tauna wese Ieisu ana toʼabiboda vonaya,
“Gwama meʼolotona baʼe beledi ana yau faibi ta wese ʼiqana magilafudi ʼinaya ʼenoʼeno, ta ʼabwaga nana ʼinega ge ana fata baʼe qabu dina kana veʼainidi.”
ʼInega Ieisu vonedi vonaya, “Tomotau qabudi ovonedi ina toabui libia.” mana diʼwe nana ʼinaya libi aqiaqina. ʼInega qabudi itoabui ta ʼidiega ʼoloto dimo adi yau ʼidewana faibi tausani (5,000).

ʼInega Ieisu beledi diavona ʼewedi ta weaqidi lukaiwa Yaubada ʼinaya, ta vewilaʼayedi tomotau ʼidia. Ta wese ʼiqana magilafudi weaqidi lukaiwa ta vewilaʼayedi qabu dina ʼidia ta iʼainidi ʼinega gamodi ʼelukoko.
Ta ʼai ʼabibodanaya Ieisu ana toʼabibodayavo vonedia, “Tomotau ʼawagigidi ona vaʼauqidi be yaqisa ge taha wese ʼidiega kana mudali.”
ʼInega Ieisu ana toʼabibodayavo beledi faibi dina ʼidiega tomotau ʼawagigidi ʼonena tuwelo iluveagatunaʼidi.
Ta tuta nana tomotau diavona Ieisu ena viaqa waiwaina baʼe iʼitea ʼinega iʼalabwau ivonaya, “Vonahaqiaqi, baʼe tovesimasimana nana ena mai bwaʼobwaʼoya weaqina Buki Nugwenugweina madusimanea.”
Ta Ieisu tomotau edi nuanua niʼa alamania tuta goyona ʼiʼimega ina kafia be ina vekinia weaqidi, ʼinega vaʼwaiva nuanidiega ta ana ʼaidega tufwana wese ʼwatovu bwanaga nana debanaya.
Ieisu tautauya lavu debanega
Ta mataʼau lavilavia ana toʼabibodayavo iwebui lavu Galili ʼinaya,
ta igelu wagaya sabi vaukamana Kafaneumi weaqina. Niʼa velovanea, ta Ieisu nawale ge damai, ʼinega iveʼale ivavaukamana.
Ta nawale itautauya malavetaya ʼinega yaqina be nufula qiduana ilobea.
Ta niʼa ivaluluvai kavona 5 nage 6 kilomita ʼidewana, ʼinega Ieisu iʼitea lavu debanega maimai edi waga diʼwenaya, ta qabudi imwaniniva.
ʼInega Ieisu vonedia, “Ge ona mwaniniva! Yaʼa tauguna.”
E ʼinega iawafelea ta gelu wagaya, ta tuta nana gelu ʼinega lukwayavonega waga nana lugu ʼabaga nana ana ʼawaboqea.
Tomotau Ieisu isalisalia

Ta qabu diavona nawale itoatoa diʼwe nana ʼinaya. ʼInega mahala vulihia ivaʼauta ta ibaʼebaʼe Ieisu sabi ʼitana, mana ialamania goluanaya Ieisu ma ana toʼabibodayavo imai edi diʼwea waga ʼaideganega. Ta wese ialamania toʼabiboda dina edi ʼevivi ʼinaya Ieisu ge dagelu ta ʼesi taudimo igelu ta ivaukamana.
ʼInega vaina waga Taibilia ʼinega imai, ta diʼwe nana goluanaya Kaiwabu beledi weaqina lukaiwa ta qabu veʼainidi ʼinaya ilugu.

Ta omoʼe ʼinaya tomotau qabudi Ieisu ma ana toʼabibodayavo isali ʼwayoqedi, ʼinega nuadi ʼeqaʼuya Ieisu ge datoatoa diʼwe nana ʼinaya. E ʼinega wagega iʼelugelu ta ivaukamana Kafaneumi ʼinaya Ieisu sabi salina.
Ieisu tauna beledi mayawaina
Ta tuta nana ilobea lavu mali diʼwenaya ʼinega ivetalaʼaiea ivonaya, “Kaiwabu, totutaya umai baʼidia?”
ʼInega Ieisu veʼiedi vonaya, “Yavona aqiaqiemi, omiʼa ge oda salisaligu egu viaqa waiwaidi weaqidi, ta ʼesi emi sali ʼiuna mana beledi diavona ʼidiega oʼai gamofata.

Omiʼa ge ona fewa ʼabwaga awahawalina weaqina, ta ʼesi ona vetafeʼwa ʼabwaga ʼenoʼeno vatayana yawaimi weaqina. Ta yaʼa Tomotau Natuna baʼe ʼabwaga nana ena neimi, mana Yaubada Tamagu venuaʼivinegu ta ʼawahaqiaqiegu baʼe fewa nana weaqina.”
Ta taudi ivonea ivonaya, “Tolaʼai luaqiaqiema be ana viaqi ʼeguma Yaubada ena nuanua ana viaqia?”
ʼInega Ieisu vonedia, “Yaubada ena nuanua baʼe ʼidewani: Yaʼa vetunegu, ta nuanuana ona vetumaqanegu.”
Ta ivoneaya, “Oʼa luaqiaqieu be taha yani ʼebenuavoqana una viaqia ana ʼitea be ʼinega ana vetumaqaneu. ʼInega tolaʼai una viaqia weaqima?
Lova tubumavo ʼabwaga taha ana wawa mana diʼwe ʼavaʼavaya iʼainia, ʼidewani Buki Nugwenugweina ʼinaya vonaya, ‘Beledi mahalega neidi ta iʼai.’”
ʼInega Ieisu tomotau diavona vonedi vonaya, “Yavona aqiaqiemi, beledi mahalega Mosese ge daneimi, ta ʼesi Tamagu beledi aqiaqi mahalega neineimi.
Ta beledi aqiaqi nana Yaubada ʼinega niʼa mai bwaʼobwaʼoya, ta tauna tomotau yawaidi neineidi.”
Ta wese Ieisu ivonea ivonaya, “Kaiwabu, tuta baʼe ʼinega benaʼe beledi nana una neima!”
ʼInega Ieisu vonedi vonaya, “Yaʼa beledi mayawaina, ta ʼeguma taha toga namai ʼiguya ʼinega ge wese nabotana, ta ʼeguma taha toga navetumaqanegu ʼinega ge wese magana naluayahaya.
Ta niʼa yavonemi, omiʼa niʼa oʼitegu ta nawale ge oda vetumaqanegu.
Ta tomeqabu Tamagu ena nuanua ʼinega neineigu, taudina ina mai ʼiguya, ta ge wese ena veniʼoledi.
Mana yaʼa mahalega yamai ge taugu egu nuanua sabi viaqina, ta ʼesi yamai agu Tovetune ena nuanua sabi viaqina.
Agu Tovetune nana egu tomotau neigu, ta ena nuanua vonigo ge taha toga ʼidiega ena nuafania be naluveʼwaiva, ta ʼesi tuta ana ʼebeluʼovoa ʼinaya ena giveyaʼitoto ʼeviviedi.
Mana Tamagu nuanuana tomeqabu yaʼa Natuna iʼitegu ta ivetumaqanegu yawai vataya ina lobea, ta tuta ana ʼebeluʼovoa ʼinaya ena giveyaʼitoto ʼeviviedi.”
Ta ena vona baʼe weaqina me Diu ivetalabeula, mana niʼa vonaya, “Yaʼa tauguna baʼe beledi nana mahalega yawebui mai.”
Ta wese taudi ivonaya, “Baʼe ʼoloto nana tauna Iosefa natuna Ieisu, waisa? Tamana be inana niʼa kahalamanidi, ta maʼoda ʼinega vonaya vonigo tauna mahalega dawebui mai?”
ʼInega Ieisu vonedi vonaya, “Ge ona vetalabeula egu vonayavo weaqidi,
mana Tamagu tauna yaʼa agu Tovetune, ta ge taha toga ana fata namai ʼiguya ʼeguma Tamagu tomotau nana ge namiei ʼiguya, ta yaʼa tuta ana ʼebeluʼovoa ʼinaya ena giveyaʼitoto ʼeviviea.

Vona baʼena lova niʼa tovesimasimana iʼwayavia Buki Nugwenugweina ʼinaya ivonaya, ‘Tomotau qabudi Yaubada ʼinega veʼita ina ʼewea, ta tomeqabu ena veʼita inoqolia ta nuadi naʼeqaʼuya, e taudina ina mai ʼiguya.’
Ge taha toga Tamagu daʼitei ta ʼesi yaʼa taugumo, mana yaʼa tauna ʼinega yamai.
“Yavona aqiaqiemi, togama vevetumaqanegu tauna yawai vataya niʼa lobea,
mana yaʼa yawai ana beledi.
Lova diʼwe ʼavaʼavaya tubumiavo ʼabwaga ana wawa mana iʼainia ta tua iʼeluʼaliga.
Ta ʼesi beledi baʼe mahalega webui mai, ta ʼeguma taha toga naʼainia ge wese naʼaliga.

Yaʼa baʼe taugu beledi mayawaina ta mahalega yawebui mai. ʼEguma taha toga baʼe beledi nana ʼinega naʼai tauna toa vataya nalobea. Ta baʼe beledi nana tauna veiʼogu, ta yaveʼineiea totoa bwaʼobwaʼo qabumi yawaimi weaqina.”
ʼInega me Diu taudiega iveʼale iveʼaeʼaetoga nuanidia ta ivonaya, “Maʼoda baʼe ʼoloto nana vonigo veiʼona naneida kana ʼainia?”
ʼInega Ieisu vonedi vonaya, “Yavona aqiaqiemi, yaʼa Tomotau Natuna, ta ʼeguma veiʼogu ge ona ʼaini ta wese ʼeguma sulaligu ge ona numei ʼinega ge ana fata yawaimi vataya ona ʼewei.
Ta ʼeguma taha toga veiʼogu naʼainia ta sulaligu nanumea tauna yawaina vataya naʼewea. Ta tuta ana ʼebeluʼovoa ʼinaya ena giveyaʼitoto ʼeviviea.
Mana veiʼogu ʼabwaga aqiaqi, ta sulaligu goʼila aqiaqi.
Ta ʼeguma taha toga veiʼogu naʼainia ta sulaligu nanumea e tauna maega niʼa aveʼaidega, ʼinega tauna ʼiguya toatoa, ta yaʼa wese ʼinaya yatoatoa.
Tamagu mayawaina vetunegu yamai, ta tauna ʼinega tuta qabuna yawaigu yaʼeweʼewea. ʼInega wese ʼidewani ʼeguma taha toga tuta qabuna ʼaiʼainigu tauna wese yawaina ʼiguyega naʼewea.
Baʼe beledi nana mahalega webui mai. Omiʼa tubumiavo mana nana iʼainia ta iʼeluʼaliga. Ta ʼeguma taha toga baʼe beledi nana ʼinega naʼai tauna toa vataya nalobea.”
Baʼe yani diavona Ieisu simana ʼifoqeyedi tuta nana veveʼita vanue tafwalolo gamonaya ʼabaga Kafaneumi ʼinaya.
Toʼabiboda ʼeala Ieisu inogea
Ta tuta nana Ieisu ana toʼabibodayavo baʼe vona diavona inoqolidi, ʼinega taudiega nuanidia ivonaya, “Baʼe vona diavona adi noqola vitana, ta toga ana fata naʼawahaqiaqiedi?”
Ieisu niʼa alamania ena vonayavo weaqina ina lugwae, ʼinega vonedi vonaya, “Nage baʼe vona diavona igivenuavitemi?
Ta maʼoda ʼeguma yaʼa Tomotau Natuna ona ʼitegu ena vane ʼevivi agu tuvadaya!

Vonahaqiaqi, Niboana Gwalagwalana yawai neineimi, ta tomotau edi waiwaiega ge adi fata toa vataya ina lobei. Ta baʼe egu vona diavona ʼidiega ana fata Yaubada Niboanina ona ʼewea, ta Niboani nana ʼinega yawaimi ona lobea.
Ta tua vaina ʼimiega nawale ge oda vetumaqanegu!” Ieisu baʼe ʼidewani vona ʼaiqa, mana tuta ana ʼebeveʼale ʼinega niʼa madualamania tomeqabu ge ida vetumaqanei, ta wese ana tosuluva niʼa alamania.
ʼInega wese vonedi vonaya, “Baʼe ʼiuna weaqina lova yavonemi ge taha toga ana fata namai ʼiguya ʼeguma Tamagu ge daʼawahaqiaqiea.”
Baʼe tuta nana ʼinega Ieisu ana toʼabibodayavo ʼeala wawasai ilugwavuʼaiea ta inogea.
ʼInega Ieisu tunugivila ta Tuwelo dina vonedi vonaya, “Nage omiʼa wese ona nogegu, waisa?”
ʼInega Saimoni Fita Ieisu vonea vonaya, “Kaiwabu! Isana togama ʼinaya ana tauya? Mana oʼa au ʼaidega otaqa eu vonayavo ʼidia yawai vataya ʼenoʼeno.
Ta imaʼa niʼa avetumaqaneu ta alamaniu vonahaqiaqi oʼa Yaubada Natuna Gwalagwalau.”
Ta Ieisu vonaya, “Vonahaqiaqi, yaʼa omiʼa Tuwelo mina yavenuaʼivinemi, ta tua taha ʼimiega kavona diabolo taha.”
Baʼe ʼidewani Ieisu vonavona Iudasa weaqina, tauna Saimoni Isakaliota natuna. Ta Iudasa nana tauna wese Tuwelo dina ʼidiega, ta tua nawale ena Kaiwabu nasuluvea.
